title: Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025
description:
Marvelous Designer 2025.0 officially released: 9 major highlights, comprehensive optimization of the creation process.  
User Interface Update: The new version enhances icon recognition, unifies visual elements, and introduces the Object Window — a centralized operation hub that makes it easier to manage various materials in your projects, including fabrics, textures, buttons, topstitching, sewing pleats, and accessories.  
Keyframe Animation: You can now set keyframes for more attributes (such as fabric physical properties, joint positions, etc.), allowing for comprehensive control over the animation performance of elements like fabrics, pattern pieces, virtual models, and wind controllers.  
Quad Mesh Optimization: The automatic quad mesh conversion feature can now generate clearer and more evenly distributed quad mesh grids, minimizing the creation of triangles, thereby enabling faster and better edge flow creation.  
IK Joint Mapping: With the IK joint mapping feature, you can more easily adjust the model's posture. Even models imported from third-party platforms such as DAZ 3D, Mixamo, iClone, or Metahuman will be automatically recognized and aligned at the joints, avoiding the complexities of manual rigging.  
UV Generation for Sides and Back: This new feature allows you to adjust UV layouts more precisely while handling complex designs, and it is compatible with other 3D software, providing greater flexibility.  
[Beta] Hair Effects Display in 3D Window: Hair effects are displayed in the 3D window, allowing for visual adjustments of hair through various parameter settings, and enabling the export of attribute settings.  
Automatic Action Conversion: Automatically convert FBX files created on other platforms into action files compatible with Marvelous Designer's default virtual models.  
Modular Library: With Marvelous Designer's modular creation process, you can efficiently create and manage reusable garment component modules, easily replacing design elements like collars and sleeves. The modular library feature will automatically recognize and categorize each module, allowing you to quickly complete combinations and designs with just a few clicks.  
New Asset Library Window: You can access over 60,000 assets from the CONNECT marketplace or create your own custom resource library while keeping the 2D and 3D windows clean and clear.

summary: ```markdown # Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025 ## User Interface Updates The user interface has been updated and redesigned for a more concise and intuitive layout. Users can freely separate, integrate, and rearrange each window. Additionally, you can save or add a customized interface layout. The window has also been improved with larger icons and a simpler layout, allowing for easy switching between the Connect Shop, Closet, and default assets. To return to the old window, click the icon in the lower left corner. The icons in the new toolbar are also easier to switch and select. The carving tool group is now integrated into the 3D toolbar for selection and switching. ## Object Window Enhancements The object window has been fully updated, making it more convenient to change the object type that needs to be adjusted. Users can easily switch between scene, fabric, sticker, button, eye, line, seal, and secondary options. To quickly browse and call the object type in the Connect Shop, click the icon in the upper left corner of the option card. ## Key Frame Animation Updates Next, let's take a look at the updates to the key frame animation feature. Users can utilize the fabric used for the versions to K-true. The K-true version name helps quickly find the corresponding version in the animation editor for subsequent operations. The K-true animation allows control over whether the K-true effect is activated. This function is particularly useful for effects like cloth falling off the frame or being held tightly in hand. The key frame animation for K-true is similar to the previous version. Users can change the position of the K-true animation in the desired scene or adjust various settings in the K-true attribute, such as sharpness. To K-true the weight and air resistance, set the simulation preset to the user's self-detection. ## K-True Animation Organization The K-true animation organization has been optimized, resulting in a neater and more accurate top structure. To display the grid structure conveniently, open the display frame and select the grid type of the version to switch to 4-split. Compared to the previous version, even a simple T-shirt style will display a cleaner and neater four-sided grid in the new version. For more complex styles like a dresser full of pleats, the new algorithm calculates a grid arrangement that maintains the details and structure of the clothing. ## 3D Window Display Hair Effect In the new version, a material type and hair material have been added. High-quality dyeing effects can now be displayed in the 3D window, with hair parameters usable in other 3D software through the USB file format. Users can set the hair display type as round, flat, or short and customize it according to their needs. ## UV Editor Enhancements The UV editor now supports the UV image of the side and back of the generated and adjusted version. To adjust the side and back of the UV image, switch to the dense texture surface first, then go to the window menu and turn on the UV editor display. Select the version needing adjustment and choose the side and back of the UV expansion option in the property bar. After selecting these options, the UV generated for the selected versions will include the side and back. When exporting the expanded UV, ensure that the unified UV coordinate option is selected in the OBJ settings. ## IK Joint Print Feature IK joint print allows users to apply Marvelous Designer's pose or animation to external FBX models, provided they use the same IK joint point structure. This feature is compatible with many virtual models downloaded from platforms like DOS3D, Mixamo, Character Creator, and MetaHuman. Import the FBX file under your T-pose, navigate to the property editor, and find the IK joint print label. You can manually set the Google joints corresponding to the IK joint or choose to automatically print. After printing, click on the T-shape position, and if the reset position option is activated, the printing is successfully completed. ## Automatic Transformation Users can download action files from external platforms like Mixamo into Marvelous Designer. Change to the default virtual model in the matching sketchbook or use your own virtual model action. In Marvelous Designer, find the virtual model in the main menu, click on Automatic Transformation as an action option, choose to convert the corresponding virtual model type, and import the downloaded FBX file. Click on Transformation to convert the animation to FBX and save the file. Now, you can apply the action to both the default and self-defined virtual models that have previously introduced the IK joint. ## Modular Drawing The new Modular Drawing function integrates and optimizes the previous modular controller and modular editor. Users can manage all clothing modules through a simple structure. After opening the Modular Drawing, click on the arrow to hide or open it. In the previous version, modules were registered through the modular editor and needed to be compiled. Now, module components can be directly registered in the Modular Drawing. The structure consists of group type, style, and component, making it easier to organize and manage various style designs. ## New Drawing Window The drawing window has been completely updated, allowing for more freedom in asset management. Users can click on the icon in the lower left corner to switch between the old and new versions of the drawing window. In the new version, users can browse built-in software assets and store assets. Free products can be directly downloaded and used in the background. The class set label allows for downloading and uploading to the cloud platform, streamlining the search and application files process. ## Style Model Rendering In the 3D window rendering option, users can select a rendering style that emphasizes lines, resembling a 2D style picture. You can adjust the outline line, sewing line, internal line, and the thickness of the bright line. This style provides a good way to view clothing patterns and design details at a glance. Users can set the background picture to pure green for use as a green screen and capture animation in the 3D window for promotional videos and demonstrations. ## Double Head Zipper The zipper type can now be selected as a double head zipper. Users can click on the zipper in the property editor and select double under the type selection. Both sides of the zipper can be pulled, and the position can be adjusted as needed. ## OBJ Zipper Pre-set The software now supports pre-set zippers to be replaced with OBJ zippers. Depending on user needs, the position of the zipper can be adjusted or a more three-dimensional OBJ zipper can be utilized for a more realistic effect. ## Virtual Model Editor Optimization All functions related to virtual models have been integrated into the virtual model editor. The creative wearing function has been moved from the 3D toolbar to this location for integrated management. Tool division is now clearer and more effective for selection. ## Automatic Adjustment Version Update The automatic adjustment version function has been optimized. Users can add additional clothing and apply the automatic adjustment version function without affecting previously worn clothing. This update improves convenience and flexibility. ## Automatic Closure The automatic closure function has been added under the Everywhere function. This feature allows users to quickly close the opening position of the clothing and brush the cover on the hidden grid. The original disk option simplifies separation and closure areas, while the 3D brush option allows users to draw a line on the clothing which will be closed according to the drawing path. After automatic closure, users can continue to complete subsequent multidirectional grid optimization in Everywhere. ```
